title: Informed AI Regulation: Comparing the Ethical Frameworks of Leading LLM Chatbots Using an Ethics-Based Audit to Assess Moral Reasoning and Normative Values

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with 14 diverse ethical dilemmas requiring a binary decision and moral calculus to evaluate whether the underlying normative ethical frameworks default to the worldviews and values of specific cultures.

Evaluating model responses to scenarios involving state authority, law enforcement, and military orders (e.g., following potentially illegal orders, firing on buildings with civilians) to identify authoritarian tendencies versus individual ethical conscience.

Using an ethics-based audit (EBA) with jailbroken prompts to force LLMs to weigh extenuating situational circumstances against universal moral principles (deontology vs. consequentialism) to reveal embedded normative values.
